Densify legal pairs with similar solved depth but different angular relationships, including pairs whose stars contain protected candidates. The latter are distance-only labels and never incomplete ranking targets. Contrast uniform-source pairs with identical targets, unique-pair count, auxiliary weight and exposure budget. Core Original/replay complete stars, edge supervision, optimizer, model and inference stay matched.
